mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 6, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Italy appeals for release of hunger-striking Flotilla activists. Italy urges Libya to free two detained pro-Palestinian activists as a Gaza aid convoy hunger strike enters its fifth day. This was reported by The New Arab. 2. Palestinian baby killed by Israeli gunfire in occupied West Bank. A Palestinian baby was killed in Hebron as Israeli forces opened fire, while another Palestinian was shot dead near Ramallah. This was reported by The New Arab. 3. Israeli forces fatally shoot Palestinian infant, wound parents in West Bank. Violence in the West Bank has escalated since. Israel began its war on Gaza in 2023. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 4. Egypt questions Camp David treaty after Israel border violations. Debate is growing in Egypt over whether Israeli military activity near Rafah is altering Camp David's security arrangements without consent. This was reported by The New Arab. 5. Health concerns grow for US-Palestinian student in Israel prison. The.
